column1: # Every SM83 (Game Boy) instruction, from pandocs' opcode table (gbdev.io/gb-opcodes/Opcodes.json), checked against
# lmmendes/game-boy-opcodes: they differ only in how they write the same instruction (SUB A,B or SUB B; LDH [C],A or
# LD (C),A; JP HL or JP (HL)), and in STOP's length, which RGBDS assembles as 10 00. The bytes are the instruction
# assembled at $0100, a tab, then how it's written.
